title: Special meeting authorizes closed session on land and legal matters
subtitle: Brief meeting covered land acquisition and potential litigation; no public debate, delegations or other business recorded.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on April 29, 2024, chaired by the Mayor. It opened at 3:03 p.m. with a land acknowledgement. No one declared a pecuniary interest, and the Mayor had no updates. One councillor joined the meeting after it began.

The only motion authorized a closed session straight after the meeting. Council agreed to it {{vote:m1}}. The session was to consider two land acquisition matters and two matters involving solicitor-client privilege and potential litigation, as permitted under the Municipal Act, 2001.

The meeting adjourned at 3:06 p.m. No decisions on these topics were made in public, and the minutes record no outcomes from the closed session. For residents, the meeting shows that the City is working on property purchases and possible legal issues. Any resulting decisions would need to be reported publicly later, at a future council meeting.

decisions.detail: Council authorized a closed session right after the special meeting to discuss two land acquisition matters and two solicitor-client privilege and potential litigation matters under the Municipal Act, 2001.
